section.title: SIMD opcodes (Vector instructions)
section.intro: SIMD (single instruction, multiple data) instructions begin with 0xFD.

opcodes.name: i8x16.shuffle
opcodes.description: Returns a new vector with lanes selected from the lanes of the two input vectors $a and $b specified in the 16 immediate operands.

opcodes.name: i8x16.swizzle
opcodes.description:
Returns a new vector with lanes selected from the lanes of the first input vector a specified in the second input vector s.

The indices i in range [0, 15] select the i-th element of 'a'. For indices outside of the range the resulting lane is 0.

opcodes.name: i8x16.splat

Constructs a vector with x replicated to all 16 lanes.

opcodes.name: i8x16.extract_lane_s
opcodes.description:
Rust: fn i8x16_extract_lane<const N: usize>(a: v128) -> i8

Extracts a lane from a 128-bit vector interpreted as 16 packed i8 numbers.

Extracts the scalar value of lane specified in the immediate mode operand N from a. If N is out of bounds then it is a compile time error.

opcodes.name: i8x16.extract_lane_u
opcodes.description: Extracts a lane from a 128-bit vector interpreted as 16 packed u8 numbers.

opcodes.name: i8x16.replace_lane
opcodes.description:
Replaces a lane from a 128-bit vector interpreted as 16 packed i8 numbers.

Replaces the scalar value of lane specified in the immediate mode operand N from 'a'. If N is out of bounds then it is a compile time error.

opcodes.name: i8x16.eq

Compares two 128-bit vectors as if they were two vectors of 16 eight-bit integers.

Returns a new vector where each lane is all ones if the corresponding input elements were equal, or all zeros otherwise.

opcodes.name: v128.not
opcodes.description: Flips each bit of the 128-bit input vector.

opcodes.name: v128.and
opcodes.description: Performs a bitwise and of the two input 128-bit vectors, returning the resulting vector.

opcodes.name: v128.andnot
opcodes.description: Bitwise AND of bits of a and the logical inverse of bits of b.

opcodes.name: v128.or
opcodes.description: Performs a bitwise or of the two input 128-bit vectors, returning the resulting vector.

opcodes.name: v128.xor
opcodes.description: Performs a bitwise xor of the two input 128-bit vectors, returning the resulting vector.

opcodes.name: v128.bitselect
opcodes.description:
Rust: fn v128_bitselect(v1: v128, v2: v128, c: v128) -> v128

Use the bitmask in c to select bits from v1 when 1 and v2 when 0.

opcodes.name: f32x4.demote_f64x2_zero
opcodes.description: Conversion of the two double-precision floating point lanes to two lower single-precision lanes of the result. The two higher lanes of the result are initialized to zero. If the conversion result is not representable as a single-precision floating point number, it is rounded to the nearest-even representable number.

opcodes.name: f64x2.promote_low_f32x4
opcodes.description: Conversion of the two lower single-precision floating point lanes to the two double-precision lanes of the result.

opcodes.name: i8x16.narrow_i16x8_s
opcodes.description:
Converts two input vectors into a smaller lane vector by narrowing each lane.

Signed saturation to 0x7f or 0x80 is used and the input lanes are always interpreted as signed integers.

opcodes.name: f32x4.ceil

opcodes.name: f32x4.floor

opcodes.name: f32x4.trunc

opcodes.name: f32x4.nearest
opcodes.description: Lane-wise rounding to the nearest integral value; if two values are equally near, rounds to the even one.

opcodes.name: i8x16.shl
opcodes.description:
Shifts each lane to the left by the specified number of bits.

Only the low bits of the shift amount are used if the shift amount is greater than the lane width.

opcodes.name: i8x16.shr_s
opcodes.description:
Shifts each lane to the right by the specified number of bits, sign extending.

Only the low bits of the shift amount are used if the shift amount is greater than the lane width.

opcodes.name: i8x16.shr_u
opcodes.description: Shifts each lane to the right by the specified number of bits, shifting in zeros.
